title: Claude Code — Budget (calendar month)
description: Monthly budget against spend. The time range is fixed to the whole calendar month in UTC (day 1 to the last day), so the chart shows the month at a glance; the stats cover the month so far.

list.name: data_source
list.label: Data source
list.description: transcript: derived from local transcripts. real-otel: Claude Code's own OTel, which carries no data_source label (matches the empty label). all: both, which double counts a machine that exports both. The built-in All (URL value $__all, kept so old bookmarks work) is the same as all (may double count). The Budget dashboard always excludes synthetic and transcript-fixture, so those two options leave its panels empty.
list.query: transcript : transcript, real-otel : ^$, all (may double count) : .*, synthetic : synthetic, transcript-fixture : transcript-fixture

panels.title: Month to date (USD)
panels.description: Month to date: this panel ignores the time picker and always covers the current month so far (panel relative time now/M). Fake data is excluded (data_source synthetic and transcript-fixture); the Data source variable applies, so keep it on one source: all counts a machine that exports both real OTel and transcripts twice.

panels.title: Projected month end (USD)
panels.description: Linear projection: month to date * days in month / days elapsed (UTC). Unstable in the first days of the month and ignores weekends. Month to date: this panel ignores the time picker and always covers the current month so far (panel relative time now/M). Fake data is excluded (data_source synthetic and transcript-fixture); the Data source variable applies, so keep it on one source: all counts a machine that exports both real OTel and transcripts twice.

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) * 0) * (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) >= bool (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) * 0)))) * days_in_month() * 86400 / ((day_of_month() - 1) * 86400 + time() % 86400)

panels.title: Cumulative cost vs budget
panels.description: Running total of cost for the calendar month in UTC, from day 1 to the last day: the dashboard range is the whole month. The cost line stops at the last day with data and the budget line spans the whole month. Fake data is excluded (data_source synthetic and transcript-fixture); the Data source variable applies, so keep it on one source: all counts a machine that exports both real OTel and transcripts twice.

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[31d] offset -1d) - (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d] @ start()) or last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[31d] offset -1d) * 0) * (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[31d] offset -1d) >= bool (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d] @ start()) or last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[31d] offset -1d) * 0))) and on() group(last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{data_source!~"synthetic|transcript-fixture",data_source=~"$data_source"}[31d] offset -31d)))
